mod_env.unit: normalized; sustained color to short modulation burst

ratio_inverse: log(ratio/0.25)/log(32); no hidden detents or pitch quantization
articulation: gate mode sustains its attack level until note-off, then decays from the exact note-off level; modulation envelope continues independently. One-shot ignores note-off.
legato: pitch changes without a new gate edge glide with 3 ms time constant; no oscillator/envelope retrigger. Host owns note priority and voice allocation.
compatibility: 0.1 tone.dsp preserved. .2 changes Punch neutrality, modulation-envelope mapping, DC/envelope ordering and live controls. Never silently substitute in old projects.
limits: one-sample feedback varies with sample rate
ordinary phase-reset retrigger may interrupt old tail
no hardware-matched ratio curve or firmware claim
